videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: DS Samantha Nixon and DC Zain Nadir arrive just in time to save Ramani De Costa from taxi driver David Russo, prime suspect in the murder case of Manisha Devi, but he is released on bail when his DNA fails to match that found near the body. Sergeant June Ackland and PC Roger Valentine are called to an arson incident - where June becomes the victim of rape.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: The relief are out looking for the teenager who raped Sergeant June Ackland. June confides in PC Sheelagh Murphy who advises her to have HIV and pregnancy tests. Thirteen-year-old Ross Trescot is found by Gabriel Kent and arrested by Tony Stamp, but when he is interviewed by DC Susie Sim he claims that he too is the victim of sexual abuse. Phil Hunter admits to his fianceé that he is already married.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Roger Valentine and Dan Casper search for a missing girl. When they discover her in some woods, it is clear that she has just given birth. Phil makes amends with Kate - unaware that his younger brother Steve has just spent a night of passion with her. On top of it all, Phil has to bid farewell to his daughter.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Acting Super Amanda Prosser arrives at Sun Hill, and Gina Gold might have finally met her match. Steve Hunter admits to Phil's ex-wife that he slept with his brother's girlfriend.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Concerned for Sergeant Smithy's safety, DC Zain Nadir introduces him to an informant who has had two fingers chopped off by Pete Larson. Zain warns Smithy that if Larson ever found out that he is sleeping with his wife, he'll end up with more than his fingers hacked off.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Super-keen and psyched up, it's Laura Bryant's first day as a PC. Despite PC Roger Valentine's practical jokes, Laura makes her first arrest and manages to get her own back on Roger before the day is out.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: The team are called upon to come and rescue the survivors of a fatal crash, and there is a bomb alert after Afghan asylum seekers are moved into a seaside hotel.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: A police pursuit ends in a crash when a car driven by teenage joyriders plunges into a deep ditch. Plus, a man falls through the floor of his local betting shop in a bizarre accident.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: The team races to save a tanker driver trapped in the wreckage of his crushed cab. Paramedic Rochers tries to save a DIY mechanic crushed by his own car.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: The team helps those affected by a major chemical spill that's endangering the lives of thousands; Paramedics get their climbing gear out to help a psychiatric patient.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: A man is shot outside a Mosque and paramedics race to save his life. His legs are peppered with shotgun pellets, but the patient won't reveal the identity of the man who pulled the trigger.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: The medics support a bomb squad as they attempt to defuse a bomb found in a house. They also treat a fugitive who held a store at knife-point and a teenager impaled on a gate.

videos.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
videos.description: The team tackle a dramatic operation where a patient's heart is stopped and restarted. Zoe has a stent replaced in her ureter, which was damaged by her treatment for cancer.

videos.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
videos.description: Trisha has an investigation of her womb to find out if she has cancer, Steve's varicose veins are stripped from his leg, and Dennis needs an operation to strengthen his eyelid.

videos.title: My Family
videos.description: Ben would do anything to get out of Christmas at home, Michael and Alfie make the most of an empty house, and Janey learns that it's tough being a mum.

videos.title: My Family
videos.description: Susan's scheme to lure Ben to a country house for a Christmas for two without the children and then `surprise' him with the family on Christmas Day is doomed to result in chaos, but that will not stop her from trying.

videos.title: My Family
videos.description: A festive edition of the family sitcom sees Ben's efforts to buy Susan's Christmas present getting him into trouble, while Susan's letter from The Palace means a change of holiday plans for everyone.

videos.title: Gavin & Stacey
videos.description: It's been ten years since we last went to Billericay to spend Christmas with the Shipmans and the Wests. This year we're off to Wales for the festivities, where Bryn's cooking dinner for over thirteen people.

videos.title: Sort Your Life Out
videos.description: Get to know the family behind the clutter, hospital director Tash, tube driver Lawrence and their four kids, and find out why their home is making them miserable. There are emotional moments as the family go through treasured items, and friction develops as they must decide what to part with. The items they do decide to let go of will be put into piles to recycle, donate or sell.

videos.title: Teleshopping
videos.description: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: Crews from West Midlands Ambulance Service attend a diabetic who has collapsed at home, reassure the wife of a man with heart problems and keep up the spirits of a woman with womb cancer.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: The paramedics treat a young mum with severe stomach pains, take a breathless pensioner to hospital and attend an elderly lady with dementia whose nose will not stop bleeding.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: Dudley crews attend a man with heart failure and sepsis, as well as a transgender patient who's in a lot of pain from an old injury. In Stoke, a patient has a panic attack in the ambulance.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: The crews are kept busy attending a man with a swollen leg, a fisherman having a stroke and a teenager whose chest pains turn out to be something totally unexpected.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: The crews go cross-country after a teenager's bike crash, attend a man who's had a nasty fall and help a woman with end-stage cancer.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance at Christmas
videos.description: Following the West Midlands Ambulance Service during the festive period. Laura and Anna are called to a man who has fallen off a roof and hit his head.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance at Christmas
videos.description: Heavy snow in the West Midlands wreaks chaos and two separate crews treat patients, both called John, who have both broken their hips after falling.

videos.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
videos.description: Pete meets some newborn pups fighting to survive, and helps teach Hugo, a Cane Corso rescued from quarantine at Dover, how to be a dog.

videos.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
videos.description: Pete helps a withdrawn pregnant Malinois regain strength so she can care for her 11 lively pups, and falls for Winter, a Staffie who is covered in scars.

videos.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
videos.description: Pete meets Flower, the first dog ever to take a dislike to him, can he win her trust? He also helps Heidi and Marvin, both facing serious medical challenges.

videos.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
videos.description: Pete helps rescue six Chihuahuas from the home of a hoarder and witnesses the emotional handover of a pregnant pug and her sister.

videos.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
videos.description: Pete meets Chow Chow Nugget who has a longer stay than planned, three-legged Tetley, and some Belgian Malinois puppies training to be service dogs.

videos.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
videos.description: Pete meets Keira, a dog on the brink of starvation, and gentle old Jack Russell Paige, whose owner had to make the heartbreaking decision to give her up after 15 years.

videos.title: The Supervet
videos.description: It might be Christmas, but Noel Fitzpatrick is busier than ever. Adam, a sleigh-pulling Alaskan malamute, needs both knees replacing with implants, and there is a six-week-old miniature dachshund puppy with a deformed foot.

videos.title: The Supervet
videos.description: The Supervet team are gearing up for Christmas at Professor Noel Fitzpatrick's practice in Surrey. Charity worker Kerry brings in Maxi, a three-year-old rescue greyhound with severely damaged front legs.

videos.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
videos.description: Teenager Nathan has two twisted teeth extracted, Bob has keyhole surgery for a groin hernia, and 96-year-old Peggy entertains the team while having a growth removed from her toe.

videos.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
videos.description: Jonathan has a camera put inside his lungs to find out if he has cancer. James needs a knee operation so he can play with his children again, and a growth is removed from Jan's ear.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: A girl suffers life-threatening breathing difficulties at school, an elderly lady is struggling with an infection and a young father experiences worrying chest pains.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: A teenager is in excruciating pain after falling and injuring his leg. Elsewhere, the paramedics treat a 94-year-old man showing signs of a stroke and another man with severe stomach pain.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: In Dudley, Ash and Jamie rush to the aid of a frightened young woman who is suffering from severe chest pains. Rachel and Mick are called to assist the police with a prisoner in Stoke.

videos.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
videos.description: Pete meets some newborn pups fighting to survive, and helps teach Hugo, a Cane Corso rescued from quarantine at Dover, how to be a dog.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: Following paramedics in Stoke as they respond to a call about a man who has collapsed with severe breathlessness, while in Dudley, crews treat a woman with a host of complex medical issues.

videos.description: The top eight chefs face a surprise and discover that they must work in pairs to cook identical dishes from opposite sides of a wall.

videos.description: In Torquay, the team and local kind volunteers step up to help single dad Stuart, who has suffered with progressive multiple sclerosis since his now 15-year-old daughter Lauren was born. His primary carer is his mother, Grandma Lin, who is blind.

videos.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
videos.description: In Plymouth, the team help the Morfey family: Chris and Tara, 24-year-old Ben, 25-year-old Josh, twins Jess and Yazz and their little brother Vinny. Both Ben and Josh suffer from cerebral palsy, and after struggling in a multi-level home in Plymouth, and without enough funds to make it disabled friendly, the family have sold up and bought a cheap, old iron forge that, when renovated, will provide single-storey living in the Plymouth countryside.
